name: Interval Set Splatting
aliases: Fast Volume Rendering of Data Slices
Fast Volume Rendering of Data Slices (Interval Set Splatting)
definition: A simple algorithm for representing and rendering 'thin' interval sets by maintaining a sorted list of data values with coordinates, using binary search to find points near a contour value, and splatting them with constant color/opacity.
summary: Interval Set Splatting renders volumetric data by maintaining a sorted list of voxels to efficiently isolate and splat specific value ranges using binary search.
